How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
To set up your bee house for the best results, mount it securely 3 to 5 feet off the ground on a sturdy wall, fence, or post facing south to southeast so it catches the morning sun.
Make sure nesting reeds are inserted with open ends facing out and pushed all the way to the back. If you are raising Mason bees, place moist, clay-rich mud within 10 to 20 feet of the house, and lightly spray InvitaBee attractant on the open ends of the reeds before releasing your cocoons.
